messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: tagged release `release-2026.03b-hotfix-2` -> prod-eu1 (canary 10%), commit `abcdef1`

deploy-bot: Artifacts: s3://redwood-builds/release-2026.03b-hotfix-2.tar.gz (sha256: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e)

jamie.ops: Ack, kicking off canary. Pinning model variant `gemini-v1-quant` for this rollout per release notes.

lee-release: Quick note — runtime pins applied: runtime-image `rwinfer:5.2.1` and kernel-set `nvf-2026-03`. Confirming healthchecks/50s window.

maria-engineering: Running preflight smoke: `curl -sS https://eu1.api.redwood/dev/health | jq .status` -> "ok" on 3/3 canaries. Logs look clean.

syd-sre: Monitoring dashboards on: latency p50/p95, error-rate, memory. Alert thresholds set: 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary stage complete (10%): no regressions detected. Rolling to 50% in 5m.

alex-prod: Hold for a quick pin request — can we pin config flag `cache_prefix_v2=true` for prod-eu1? If not present we might see cache thrash.

jamie.ops: Good catch. Pinned `cache_prefix_v2=true` on prod-eu1. Proceeding.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% started.

maria-engineering: Seeing a small spike in 502s from one backend pool: `nlb-be-12`. Pattern: upstream connection reset. Investigating.

syd-sre: I see the same, 502s at ~1.2% concentrated to eu-central AZ-B. Rolling back traffic from that AZ to spillover nodes.

lee-release: Proposal: pause global ramp and isolate the canary region for rollback while continuing rollout in unaffected AZs. Opinions?

alex-prod: +1 continue in unaffected AZs, isolate eu-central AZ-B. We should avoid a full rollback if issue isolated to infra.

jamie.ops: Agreed. Action plan: 1) revert traffic for AZ-B to previous instance group 2) keep release pinned in other AZs 3) open incident if 5xx persists beyond 10m.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift executed: eu-central AZ-B -> stable pool. Canary global ramp paused.

maria-engineering: After traffic shift, 502s dropped back to baseline in 3m. Service latencies stable.

lee-release: Can we resume 50% for non-affected AZs? That keeps progress without risking user impact.

alex-prod: Resuming for non-affected AZs only. I'll coordinate ops to watch session affinity edges.

deploy-bot: Resume partial ramp: 50% excluding eu-central AZ-B. Will re-evaluate in 10m.

jamie.ops: Logging decision: do not rollback tagged release `release-2026.03b-hotfix-2` globally. Isolate and mitigate. Create follow-up ticket to root-cause infra resets.

lee-release: Filing ticket RN-1842 for NLB connection resets and adding postmortem entry.

maria-engineering: Post-deploy smoke again: all checks green in promoted regions.

deploy-bot: Final status (after 15m): Promoted to 90% excluding eu-central AZ-B. Canary flag: `canary_status=partial`

jamie.ops: Thanks all. Will keep this thread pinned to the release record. :white_check_mark:
